rows.grounds: compound: kaṭu (pungent) + taila (oil) + vimiśrita (mixed); instrumental plural qualifying oblation materials
conjunction connecting to prior ritual means
ablative indicating source or means of the effect
compound: tri (three) + muni (seven) + vāsara (days), indicating a period of twenty-one days
main verb expressing the result of the oblation

items.question: By what oblation do enemies perish within twenty-one days?
premises: Oblations are performed with substances mixed with pungent oil.
The ritual effect unfolds over twenty-one days.
Enemies are the targets of this oblation.
items.inference: Oblations mixed with pungent oil cause enemies to die within twenty-one days.
items.plain_english: And from oblations mixed with pungent oil, enemies die within twenty-one days.
